item.title: Microsoft makes environmental, job commitments for data center coming to Person County
item.description: Tech giant Microsoft purchased 1,350 acres of land in Person County in October 2024, where it plans to build and operate a data center.

item.title: Student with 'bladed weapon' threatens others, sending Garner elementary school into lockdown, police say
item.description: A Wake County elementary school went on lockdown Wednesday afternoon when a student threatened others with a "bladed weapon" after becoming "upset" during a parent meeting with school administrators, Garner police said.

item.title: Amid increase in GLP-1 demand, CBS 17 investigates effect of weight loss drugs on people, pharmaceutical industry
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) — It’s estimated that about one in 10 Americans have taken a GLP‑1 weight‑loss drug, and demand is surging. Ads are everywhere, but so are concerns about safety, cost and where some people are getting these medications. “They’re incredibly effective for weight loss,” said Dr. Jennifer McCauley with UNC Health.
